data.title: Nvidia Barely Moved. These 2 AI Connectivity Stocks Jumped More Than 7%
data.description: Nvidia rose only 0.8% on September 4, while Astera Labs jumped 9.8% and Marvell gained 7.1%. The comparison was consistent with investors broadening the AI trade beyond accelerators into connectivity suppliers. Astera’s rally also coincided with speculation that the company could be added to the S&P 500, although it was ultimately not selected in the […]
